## DuckyScript guidance

Link: https://github.com/dekuNukem/duckyPad-Pro/blob/master/doc/duckyscript_for_ai.md

Please visit and read the linked duckyscript_for_ai.md document thoroughly before suggesting or making any changes related to duckyPad Pro duckyscript.
